description.value: Dark sheets tens of metres across that hold station against the zonal winds at the top of a giant's cloud deck, apparently for the whole of a life cycle nobody has observed. Two probes have gone into the Bellows population: one returned spectra suggesting photosynthesis of a sort, the other returned nothing whatever. The Windlass f identification rests on a single spectrum that one reviewer still disputes in print.
